selection: Score both prespecified policies. Accuracy selects by pooled inner correct count, macro-F1, then candidate order. Severe-aware applies the same ranking among candidates with inner severe recall and precision >= 0.20; if none qualify, use the accuracy choice and record gate failure. Only selected models score on outer folds.
augmentation: Fit scaler/PCA on real fitting participants first. Only class-4 fitting vectors may be interpolated with one of their two nearest class-4 fitting neighbors. Target severe count is min(class-3 count, four times original class-4 count). Store parent indices and interpolation fractions. No synthetic participants, PHQ scores, text, labels, validation or test records are created. Normalize effective fitting weight to original real-participant count.
scope: Same verified MiniLM features, participants, five classes and folds as audited 48.47% strategy. No feature/encoder change, no new validation/test scoring, no deployment refit. Original study and audits remain unchanged.
limitations: Post-final exploratory repair of severe-blind selection after repeated searches. Gate is an inner-selection constraint, not a promise of outer severe detection. Synthetic vectors add no independent participants or clinical evidence. Report all policies and repeats without choosing a winner using outer results.
